bob_share_balance_before_queue.meaning: Bob's balance of GTL shares before queueing the withdrawal order

shares_burned_at_queueing.meaning: whether the shares for the queued withdrawal were burned when queueing the withdrawal order in queueWithdrawal

shares_minted_back_on_cancel.meaning: whether the shares were minted back when a queue order is canceled in cancelWithdrawal

processing_withdrawal_reverted_on_burn.meaning: whether processing the withdrawal reverted on burn because Bob had zero balance of shares

assumptions: Bob's share balance is a positive integer quantity of GTL shares before queueing.

unresolved.description: The intent states a burn-at-queueing / mint-back-on-cancel obligation, but the report does not state a distinct completion or non-revert obligation for processing a withdrawal; the required_effect effect slot can only restate the mint-back-on-cancel occurrence, so the progress/liveness relation is not fully expressible from the frozen intent alone.

limitations: The intent's burn-at-queueing and mint-back-on-cancel clauses are encoded as the condition and effect respectively; the report does not describe a cancel scenario for this impact.
The impact's zero-share-balance cause is captured only in the impact_outcome symbol meaning, not as a separate precondition.

relationship_trace.gap: No explicit report path links the frozen intent (burn at queueing / mint back on cancel) to the frozen impact (processing withdrawal reverts on burn); the report's root-cause excerpts describe burning at processing time, not the intent's queueing-time burn obligation.
